Streaming JSON object iteration (ObjectEach), value typing and Unescape from github.com/buger/jsonparser v1.1.1.

This is an individually licensed generic JSON primitive, not Loki telemetry/parser/evaluator code; the LogQL json stage logic around it is first-party.
Files are included unmodified (adapted SHA-256 equals original). The gofuzz harness (fuzz.go) and non-Go project files are excluded.
Exact pinned vendor source URLs, the independent Go module proxy cross-check, SHA-256 values and exclusions are in provenance.json.
